title: Morse functions with regular level sets consisting of $2$-dimensional spheres, $2$-dimensional tori, or Klein Bottles
summary: In this paper, we study Morse functions with regular level sets consisting of spheres, tori, or Klein Bottles on $3$-dimensional closed manifolds. We characterize $3$-dimensional manifolds represented by connected sums each of whose summands is the product $S^1 \times S^2$ of the circle $S^1$ and the sphere $S^2$, lens spaces, or non-orientable closed and connected manifolds of genus $1$ by a certain subclass of such Morse functions.
